#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    string line;
    while (getline(cin, line)) {
        if (line.empty()) continue;
        istringstream iss(line);
        int n;
        iss >> n;
        if (iss.fail()) break;
        string s;
        getline(cin, s);
        bool inside = false;
        bool wordStart = true;
        int insideWords = 0;
        string cur, best;
        for (int i = 0; i < n && i < (int)s.size(); i++) {
            char c = s[i];
            if (c == '(') {
                inside = true;
                wordStart = true;
                cur.clear();
            } else if (c == ')') {
                inside = false;
                cur.clear();
            } else if (!inside) {
                if (c == '_') {
                    cur.clear();
                } else {
                    cur += c;
                }
                if (cur.size() > best.size()) {
                    best = cur;
                }
            } else {
                if (c == '_') {
                    wordStart = true;
                } else if (wordStart) {
                    insideWords++;
                    wordStart = false;
                }
            }
        }
        cout << best.size() << " " << insideWords << endl;
    }
    return 0;
}
